name: Realtime Ambilight
description: Server-side realtime Ambilight output to WLED
overview: Realtime HDR-aware ambient lighting for Jellyfin playback

versions.changelog: Adds Philips Hue Entertainment as a second, independent realtime output alongside WLED (same picture, same bound TV, off by default). Adds a settings-page overhaul: overview cards that expand in place, one combined "edit all settings" page, live pipeline/device status, live activity log, device reachability pings, colour-deviation breakdown, and a reset-to-defaults action. Adds WLED settings management (realtime pixel offset, nightlight interference) and 200+ unit tests. Several real bugs found and fixed against physical hardware over multiple hands-on test rounds (see the project's ADRs and commit history).
First installable pre-alpha release: server-side video analysis driving WLED in realtime, with calibration and RGBW output. Hue integration was not yet included.
